breaking_news.headline: Middle East supply risk lifts oil and long yields, triggering a technology-led Wall Street selloff
breaking_news.summary: WTI settled at $84.94 and Brent at $91.02 while the 10-year Treasury yield traded around 4.71%; high-duration technology valuations came under pressure.
breaking_news.market_impact: Higher energy and long yields raise inflation and discount-rate pressure.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Negative near-term valuation read-through for Taiwan AI/semiconductor leaders; confirm with TSM ADR and TX night futures.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. semiconductor shares reverse sharply; SOX drops about 5%
breaking_news.summary: SOX fell about 5%; Nvidia lost 2.34% to $219.74, AMD fell about 4.3% to $484.39 and Micron dropped about 7%.
breaking_news.market_impact: Broad de-risking in recent AI/semiconductor winners as yields rise.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Negative for TSMC, CoWoS, AI-server ODM, PCB, networking, cooling, power and memory sentiment.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. July import prices fall 0.4%, below expectations
breaking_news.summary: Import prices fell 0.4% m/m after a revised 0.3% June decline; petroleum import prices fell 7.5%, non-petroleum prices rose 0.3%.
breaking_news.market_impact: Disinflationary at the margin, but overshadowed by renewed oil/geopolitical pressure and elevated long yields.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Macro relief is secondary to the rate/oil shock for Taiwan technology valuation.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Nvidia falls 2.34%; financing exposure remains under scrutiny before Aug. 26 earnings
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Nvidia closed at $219.74. A filing disclosed an SB Energy partnership involving up to $105 billion of financing for an Ohio data center with OpenAI as tenant.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Near-term multiple pressure from yields and financing-risk debate; Aug. 26 earnings become the next demand validation point.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: High relevance for TSMC, CoWoS, AI server ODM, networking, PCB, cooling and power suppliers.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AMD falls about 4.3% in broad semiconductor de-risking
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: AMD closed around $484.39 as the semiconductor group sold off sharply.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Confirms a sector-wide high-beta AI compute selloff rather than a single-company shock.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Negative sentiment read-through for TSMC and Taiwan AI hardware beta; no new AMD demand warning identified.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Apple rises 1.45% while analysts debate deeper Nvidia AI collaboration
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Apple outperformed the falling market; a fresh analyst note argued a deeper Nvidia relationship could strengthen Apple's AI position.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Relative strength contrasts with the semiconductor selloff.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Potential long-run relevance for Apple supply-chain and AI inference hardware; not a confirmed partnership.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: No separate material TSMC company announcement identified; sector signal dominated by SOX, Nvidia and AMD weakness
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Use same-date TSM ADR, TX night futures and USD/TWD validation to calibrate the expected Taiwan opening gap.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Macro discount-rate pressure dominates company-specific news flow.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Do not infer the Taiwan open from SOX alone.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Microsoft edges higher about 0.27% despite broad technology weakness
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Microsoft showed relative resilience; no new high-confidence company-specific catalyst was identified in the research window.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Megacap software resilience did not offset chip weakness.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Cloud capex remains structurally important but no new Microsoft-specific supply-chain signal appeared.

narration_points: 昨夜美股連續第三個交易日收低，科技與半導體成為主要壓力來源。
S&P 500 跌 0.69%，NASDAQ 跌 1.33%，道瓊跌 0.22%，Russell 2000 跌約 1.3%。
市場核心變數重新轉向油價與長債殖利率：WTI 收 84.94 美元，10 年債殖利率約在 4.71% 高檔。
Finviz 熱力圖應聚焦科技股與半導體普遍偏弱，以及能源、防禦類股相對抗跌。
SOX 約跌 5%，NVIDIA 收 219.74 美元跌 2.34%，AMD 收 484.39 美元跌約 4.3%；台積電 ADR 精確收盤等待同交易日驗證。
中東供應風險持續推升通膨與利率壓力，這對高估值 AI 類股形成折現率逆風。
美國 7 月進口價格月減 0.4%，帶來部分通膨緩解訊號，但尚不足以壓過油價與長債風險。
台股開盤前最後確認台指期 8 月 19 日歸屬夜盤、OI、台積電 ADR 與美元新台幣；只有日期一致才補值。
今晚最大事件是聯準會公布 7 月 28 到 29 日會議紀要，同時留意 Lowe's、Target 與 Analog Devices 財報。
